ideas.hook: the lowercase word emberwick where the i is a thin, gently bent wick and its dot a rounded, smouldering coal set slightly apart
ideas.means: the name drawn inside its own letters: wick + ember, the slow glow of roasting rather than a flame

review.reading: the word emberwick with a candle-like i and a warm dot; the dotted-i swap is a common wordmark trick, needs a very specific wick shape

ideas.hook: a capital W drawn as two plaited strands that cross and re-cross, like a braided cotton wick
ideas.means: craft and patience; many strands (eight farms) twisted into one supply

review.reading: a woven/braided W; risk of rope or challah reading (rustic) if the plait is drawn loosely

ideas.hook: a metal type sort seen from above: a softened rectangle with a mirror-reversed lowercase e raised in its face
ideas.means: the printworks the roastery lives in; the brand as something you press and stamp

review.reading: a rounded slug with a mirror-reversed e: a printer's type sort, reads stamp-like, ownable via the printworks; risk of generic app-tile if the sort body is just a rounded square

ideas.hook: eight short tapered strokes of different lengths converging on one solid round core, like threads gathered into a knot
ideas.means: eight farms traced directly to one roastery

review.reading: a sunburst / asterisk starburst, stock radial cliché

ideas.hook: a pebble-like rounded coal shape with one irregular hairline crack glowing through it in the warm colour
ideas.means: an ember after the flame has gone: heat held quietly, the roast's inner warmth

review.reading: a coffee bean: rounded oval with a crack line through it, the banned product object

ideas.hook: a pitched-roof house outline whose doorway is filled by one round glowing coal
ideas.means: wick = Old English wic, a dwelling: a hearth-home for coffee

review.reading: a home/house UI icon

ideas.hook: a round roast-date stamp: a thick ring with a gap at the top, a single short tick marking where the date sits
ideas.means: roasted and shipped within 48 hours; the stamp that goes on every bag

review.reading: a power button / timer / loading ring UI glyph

ideas.hook: the word Emberwick in a high-contrast warm serif where c and k are joined into one printer's ligature by a single shared curl
ideas.means: a crafted, editorial voice; the printworks' type case

review.reading: Emberwick in a warm editorial serif with a distinctive ck ligature; the ligature must carry the avatar alone

ideas.hook: a solid circle whose lower edge is printed slightly heavier and offset, like an ink impression that bit unevenly into paper
ideas.means: pressed by hand; small batches, each a little different

review.reading: a plain dot with a drop shadow; no specific form

ideas.hook: three stacked horizontal bars that grow thicker downward, the bottom one glowing warm, forming the arms of a capital E
ideas.means: heat building through the roast toward the glowing bed of embers

review.reading: a hamburger menu icon / E built from stacked bars (initial with a cut)

ideas.hook: a lowercase e and w sharing one stroke: the e's crossbar runs out and becomes the first stroke of the w, like a single drawn thread
ideas.means: one continuous line from farm to roaster to cup; traceability as an unbroken line

review.reading: the word 'ew' (disgust) for a food brand; a generic script monogram

ideas.hook: a shipping tag shape with a punched hole, its body a warm solid with a small reversed initial
ideas.means: every bag labelled with its farm; provenance you can hold

review.reading: a price/shipping tag UI icon with an initial

ideas.hook: two nested soft rounded shapes, a dark crust around an off-centre warm core, like a coal broken open
ideas.means: the glow inside: quiet confidence, heat that is held not shown

review.reading: a fried egg or an eye: off-centre core in a soft blob

ideas.hook: a slow spiral of one tapered stroke turning twice, thick outside and thinning to a point at the centre, like a coil of wick
ideas.means: the slow turn of the roasting drum and the coiled wick: patience

review.reading: a generic spiral / loading swirl / snail shell

ideas.hook: a solid disc printed as a halftone: dots large and merged on the lower left, shrinking to tiny dots at the upper right, like a coal's glow reproduced on a printing press
ideas.means: ember warmth rendered in the printworks' own technique; heat fading out

review.reading: a halftone gradient ball, the stock print-effect sphere; the dots vanish at 32 px and leave a plain blob

ideas.hook: a printer's manicule (the old pointing-hand ornament ☞) drawn in a few heavy, simplified strokes, its fingertip ending in a small glowing round coal
ideas.means: pointing to the source: traceability; the printworks' typographic heritage

review.reading: a pointing-hand cursor / pointing emoji (link UI glyph); the coal reads as a fingertip blob

ideas.hook: the word Emberwick fully legible in a warm, sturdy serif, every letter intact, with the counters of e, b and e filled solid copper like glowing coals inside the type
ideas.means: embers glowing inside the word itself; warmth held within, not shown off

review.reading: the word Emberwick intact with small solid coals sitting in the e, b, e counters; must keep a clear gap around each coal so one-colour print does not clog into blobs, and the avatar e-with-coal must not read as an eye

ideas.hook: a printer's asterism (three small six-pointed stars in a triangle ⁂) where each star is a soft, rounded spark, the top one copper
ideas.means: the typesetter's section mark: a pause, a new chapter; small sparks from the roast

review.reading: three sparkles in a triangle: the AI sparkle / star-rating icon

ideas.hook: two overlapping discs slightly out of register, ink brown and copper, their overlap a darker lens — the slip of a two-colour print run
ideas.means: the printworks and the roast: two passes, one impression; small-batch imperfection

review.reading: two overlapping circles: a Venn diagram / the Mastercard logo; overlap is lost in one colour

ideas.hook: a wide rounded lozenge, the classic printer's diamond ornament, softened and cut by one thin horizontal glowing seam across its middle
ideas.means: a coal split open showing its glow, drawn as a type ornament

review.reading: a rounded oval split by a line: a coffee bean (banned object) or a pill/eye

ideas.hook: the word Emberwick set in capitals in a crisp serif, with the W cut as a deep ink-trap ligature where its two inner strokes meet and glow copper in the trap
ideas.means: printworks craft in the type itself; a small ember at the heart of the name

review.reading: EMBERWICK in crisp serif capitals with a small warm spot in the W's central notch; word stays whole, but the avatar W alone risks a stock serif monogram, so the trap must be big and specific

ideas.hook: an eight-pointed rosette of soft, rounded petals like a printer's fleuron, one petal copper and the rest ink
ideas.means: eight farms, one of them in this bag; the traceable single origin

review.reading: a daisy / flower icon or pinwheel; the one-copper-petal idea dies in one-colour stamping
